blurb: Guests can take helicopter tours with informative pilot commentary or enroll in flight training courses including private pilot, instrument, commercial, and instructor certifications. Training uses Robinson helicopters and includes ground and flight lessons. Tours operate Monday through Saturday with various pricing options.
